item.title: Deadly Incident at CFB Wainwright Triggers Fire and Edmonton Disaster Response
item.description: An undisclosed incident at Alberta's primary military training grounds leaves fatalities, injuries, and a wildfire burning beyond the perimeter fence.

item.title: Rep. Ilhan Omar Lawyers Accuse Feds of Violating Search Restrictions
item.description: Rep. Ilhan Omar's legal team demands the return of seized items, alleging federal investigators breached strict judicial limits imposed on a home search weeks before election day.
item.dc:creator: NewsXphere Editorial Desk

item.title: Katie Zacharia Fired After Five Days as White House Press Secretary
item.description: Katie Zacharia has been ousted after just five days as White House press secretary, setting an all-time record for the shortest tenure in the role following briefing missteps and scrutiny over her credentials.
item.dc:creator: NewsXphere Editorial Desk

item.title: Musk Points to Trump for Sudden Starshield Limits Choking Ukraine Drones
item.description: Following front-line drone connection drops, Elon Musk declared that the Pentagon and Donald Trump decide operational curbs on Starshield.
item.dc:creator: NewsXphere Editorial Desk

item.title: Judge Halts Trump Administration Tree Cutting at D.C. Golf Course
item.description: A federal judge issued a restraining order against the Trump administration's East Potomac Golf Course overhaul after 430 trees were felled in a single weekend.
item.dc:creator: NewsXphere Editorial Desk

item.title: Trump Announces Deal with Putin to Release Russian Diesel Globally
item.description: Washington grants a sanctions waiver through 2027 after Trump claims Putin agreed to release over 4 million tons of diesel into global markets.
item.dc:creator: NewsXphere Editorial Desk

item.title: Hurricane Polo Explodes to Category 5
item.description: In under 24 hours the system went from tropical storm to a 180 mph monster with 892 mb pressure. Live track, rainfall threats for Mexico, and the next 48 hours.
item.dc:creator: Monu Sharma

item.title: Shelley Fabares, 'Coach' & 'Donna Reed Show' Star
item.description: The Emmy-nominated actress and "Johnny Angel" singer passed away Saturday in Los Angeles, surrounded by husband Mike Farrell and family, who have asked for privacy as tributes arrive from co-star Craig T. Nelson and fans of classic television.

item.title: AI Is Eating Software: How Agentic AI Is Quietly Replacing the Cloud
item.description: Developers are pulling AI workloads off rented GPUs and back onto their own machines — trading a monthly API invoice for a quantized model that never phones home.

item.title: The Hidden Battle Over Who Secretly Owns Your Digital Footprint
item.description: While global regulators step up scrutiny on non-transparent data practices, millions of web users remain unaware of what lies inside updated terms of service.
